title: Free Worcester Stew
description: A hearty stew made with tender beef and vegetables, flavored with Worcestershire sauce.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, carrot, and potato to the pot.
Add the Worcestershire sauce, beef broth, tomato paste, and thyme to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Skim off any excess fat before serving.
Serve with crusty bread or over mashed potatoes.
